title: NW London Bridging Loan
summary: Case study of a GBP 19 million gross bridging loan (development-exit style refinance) arranged by Silver Oak Capital for a developer completing a 25-apartment luxury residential scheme in North West London. The developer had run over on the build schedule, so the scheme was only about 80% complete when the outstanding development and mezzanine (Mezz) facilities needed refinancing; the bridge was used to allow more time to market and sell the remaining units. Challenge: finding a lender willing to fund a partly finished residential scheme, which required presenting a clear exit and marketing plan backed by a strong valuation report. Terms stated on the page (per search summaries): GBP 19m gross, 0.75% per month, 12-month term, maximum 73% LTV, 15% personal guarantee. Independent trade coverage (Bridging & Commercial, dated 2 March 2020) describes it as Silver Oak Capital's largest ever bridging loan at GBP 19.1m, funded by Topland Group at 70% LTV over 12 months, including a GBP 1.2m capex facility for final finishing work. Borrower type: property developer. Lender: Topland Group (named only in trade press, not in the case-study snippets). Outcome: completed (per trade-press headline 'completes'); the case-study snippets themselves do not surface an explicit outcome sentence.
